name: Randomix
tagline: Roll dice, flip coins and pick at random
description:
Randomix settles arguments. Spin a roulette to choose between the options you type in or a range of numbers, flip a coin, throw dice, or ask a magic ball a question and let it answer for you.

The roulette keeps your recent lists so you can pin, delete or bring one back, and it has ready-made presets for letters, cards and plain numbers. The dice are d4, d6, d10, d12 and d20, up to ten at a time. You can write your own magic ball answers, and turn sounds and vibration on or off.

It follows your Material You colours with light, dark and AMOLED themes, is about 4 MB, and has been translated into a long list of languages.
